source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/111_非激光光源与光辐射防护.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/111_非激光光源与光辐射防护/src.py

points.K1: 光源的分类：五类非激光光源
points.K4: 荧光灯：汞蒸气放电发光
points.K5: 高强度放电灯：外壳破了漏紫外

points.K10: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
points.S1: 受照后报告就医与废灯管处置

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排台灯、灯管、紫外灯中间，对镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands among a desk lamp, a tube lamp and a small violet lamp, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲非激光光源和光辐射防护。
overlay: 非激光光源与光辐射防护

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰卷着袖子、不戴眼镜，凑近紫外灯看色谱板
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, sleeves rolled up and no glasses, leans close to a violet lamp to look at a small white plate.
shots.narration: 阿杰没戴眼镜，凑近紫外灯看板。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 夜里阿杰捂着眼睛，眼睛发红流泪
shots.prompt_en: At night the young male student covers his red, watering eyes with both hands in pain.
shots.narration: 夜里他眼睛刺痛流泪，睁不开。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研陪阿杰去找老周报告，再去医院
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student to the older man to report, then points towards a clinic.
shots.narration: 小研说：紫外看不见，也会伤眼。

shots.section_title: 光源的分类：五类非激光光源
shots.scene: 太阳和闪电在左，灯泡和灯管在右
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sun and lightning on the left, a light bulb and a tube lamp on the right. No text.
shots.narration: 光源分自然光源和人造光源。
overlay: 光源的分类：五类非激光光源

shots.section_title: 光源的分类：五类非激光光源
shots.scene: 人造光源分成两个框：普通灯和激光器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: man-made light sources split into two boxes, ordinary lamps and a laser device. No text.
shots.narration: 人造光源又分非激光光源和激光。

shots.section_title: 光源的分类：五类非激光光源
shots.scene: 五个灯具图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five lamp icons in a row, a bulb, a tube lamp, a high power lamp, a flash tube and a small diode lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 常见非激光光源有五类。

shots.section_title: 光源的分类：五类非激光光源
shots.scene: 五个灯具图标下各挂一个不同的警示小图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the five lamp icons, each with a different small warning icon beneath it, heat, broken glass, violet rays and lightning. No text.
shots.narration: 每类光源，危害和防护各不同。

shots.section_title: 白炽灯与卤钨灯
shots.scene: 灯泡剖面，钨丝烧得白亮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway light bulb with a coiled metal filament glowing white hot. No text.
shots.narration: 白炽灯靠钨丝烧到白热发光。

shots.section_title: 白炽灯与卤钨灯
shots.scene: 钨丝旁画高温计，灯泡里充满惰性气体小点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a filament beside a high thermometer, the bulb filled with small dots of inert gas. No text.
shots.narration: 钨耐高温，灯泡里充惰性气体护丝。

shots.section_title: 白炽灯与卤钨灯
shots.scene: 普通灯泡玻壳发黑，卤钨灯把钨原子送回灯丝
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an old bulb with a blackened glass wall beside a halogen bulb where metal atoms return to the filament in a loop. No text.
shots.narration: 卤钨灯加卤素，把钨送回灯丝。

shots.section_title: 白炽灯与卤钨灯
shots.scene: 直灯丝和螺旋灯丝并排
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a straight filament next to a coiled filament that holds a much longer wire. No text.
shots.narration: 灯丝绕成螺旋，能装进更长的丝。

shots.section_title: 白炽灯与卤钨灯
shots.scene: 密绕灯丝亮而匀，疏绕灯丝便宜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tightly coiled filament glowing bright and even beside a loosely coiled cheaper one. No text.
shots.narration: 密绕更亮更匀，疏绕更便宜。

shots.section_title: 白炽灯和卤素灯很烫
shots.scene: 石英玻壳的卤素灯冒出热浪
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small halogen lamp with a quartz bulb, strong heat waves rising from it. No text.
shots.narration: 卤素灯要很热，玻壳用石英。

shots.section_title: 白炽灯和卤素灯很烫
shots.scene: 手指去摸亮着的灯泡，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger reaching to touch a lit bulb, crossed out with a red mark. No text.
shots.narration: 白炽类的灯都很烫，别用手碰。

shots.section_title: 白炽灯和卤素灯很烫
shots.scene: 纸张和溶剂瓶靠着灯具，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: paper sheets and a solvent bottle placed against a hot lamp, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 灯旁不放纸张和易燃溶剂。

shots.section_title: 白炽灯和卤素灯很烫
shots.scene: 关灯、等冷却、戴手套换灯泡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off a lamp, a thermometer cooling down, then a gloved hand changing the bulb. No text.
shots.narration: 关灯冷却再换，不徒手摸石英壳。

shots.section_title: 荧光灯：汞蒸气放电发光
shots.scene: 荧光灯管剖面，电子撞上汞原子放出紫外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway tube lamp, electrons striking metal vapour atoms that give off violet rays. No text.
shots.narration: 荧光灯里，电子撞汞原子放紫外。
overlay: 荧光灯：汞蒸气放电发光

shots.section_title: 荧光灯：汞蒸气放电发光
shots.scene: 紫外打到管壁荧光粉上，变成白光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: violet rays hitting the powder coating on the tube wall and turning into white visible light. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外打到荧光粉，变成可见光。

shots.section_title: 荧光灯：汞蒸气放电发光
shots.scene: 三个小人传接力棒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three small runners passing a relay baton, an electron, an atom and a powder grain. No text.
shots.narration: 像接力：电子传汞，汞传荧光粉。

shots.section_title: 荧光灯：汞蒸气放电发光
shots.scene: 冷阴极和热阴极两个电极图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two electrode icons, one marked with a fast clock and one with an energy saving leaf. No text.
shots.narration: 冷阴极启动快，热阴极更省电。

shots.section_title: 荧光灯：汞蒸气放电发光
shots.scene: 长短两根灯管，长管旁可见光柱更高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long tube and a short tube, the long one beside a taller visible light bar. No text.
shots.narration: 光效看电能变成多少可见光。

shots.section_title: 荧光灯：汞蒸气放电发光
shots.scene: 灯管连着一个镇流器盒子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tube lamp wired to a small ballast box, glowing evenly. No text.
shots.narration: 镇流器选得对，灯更亮更长寿。

shots.section_title: 高强度放电灯：外壳破了漏紫外
shots.scene: 放电灯内管里一道电弧发出强光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a high power discharge lamp, a bright arc burning inside its small inner tube. No text.
shots.narration: 高强度放电灯靠电弧发光。
overlay: 高强度放电灯：外壳破了漏紫外

shots.section_title: 高强度放电灯：外壳破了漏紫外
shots.scene: 三种放电灯并排，内管有压力表图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three discharge lamps side by side, each inner tube with a small pressure gauge icon. No text.
shots.narration: 有汞灯、钠灯和金属卤化物灯。

shots.section_title: 高强度放电灯：外壳破了漏紫外
shots.scene: 内管发出紫外，被外玻壳挡在里面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: violet rays from the inner tube being stopped by the outer glass envelope. No text.
shots.narration: 外玻壳的作用，是挡住紫外线。

shots.section_title: 高强度放电灯：外壳破了漏紫外
shots.scene: 外壳裂开，灯还亮，紫外射出来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the outer envelope cracked, the lamp still glowing and violet rays escaping through the gap. No text.
shots.narration: 外壳破了灯还亮，紫外就漏出来。

shots.section_title: 高强度放电灯：外壳破了漏紫外
shots.scene: 手臂皮肤发红，眼睛发炎
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reddened forearm and an inflamed red eye, with warning symbols. No text.
shots.narration: 会灼伤皮肤，引起眼睛发炎。

shots.section_title: 高强度放电灯：外壳破了漏紫外
shots.scene: 手拉下电闸，灯上挂停用牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off the power and a blank out of service tag hanging on the cracked lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 外壳破损，立即断电停用。

shots.section_title: 高强度放电灯：外壳破了漏紫外
shots.scene: 外壳一破，灯自动熄灭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp whose outer envelope breaks and the lamp switches itself off at once. No text.
shots.narration: 可选外壳一破就自动熄灭的灯。

shots.section_title: 闪光灯与弧光灯
shots.scene: 螺旋形和直管形闪光灯管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a coiled flash tube and a straight flash tube glowing bright white. No text.
shots.narration: 闪光灯和弧光灯也是放电灯。

shots.section_title: 闪光灯与弧光灯
shots.scene: 相机闪光和激光器里的泵浦灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a camera flash and a flash tube inside a laser housing. No text.
shots.narration: 用在摄影和激光器里。

shots.section_title: 闪光灯与弧光灯
shots.scene: 灯管充氙气，高压电源连着电容
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas filled flash tube connected to a high voltage supply with a capacitor and a lightning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 靠高压触发，断电后电容仍可能带电。

shots.section_title: 闪光灯与弧光灯
shots.scene: 灯管外套着水套，水流带走热量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flash tube inside a water jacket, flowing water carrying the heat away. No text.
shots.narration: 发光强、发热大，常用水冷却。

shots.section_title: LED：PN结发光
shots.scene: 显示屏、遥控器、手电里的小LED
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small diode lights in a display, a remote control and a torch. No text.
shots.narration: LED用在显示屏、遥控器和照明。

shots.section_title: LED：PN结发光
shots.scene: PN结画成一道门槛
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a junction drawn as two zones, one full of electrons and one full of holes, with a low gate between them. No text.
shots.narration: PN结像一道单向的门。

shots.section_title: LED：PN结发光
shots.scene: 正接电流通过，反接被挡住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: forward connection with current flowing through the gate, reverse connection with the gate raised and current blocked. No text.
shots.narration: 正接电流通过，反接被挡住。

shots.section_title: LED：PN结发光
shots.scene: 电子落进空穴，放出一个光子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electron dropping into a hole and releasing a small glowing photon. No text.
shots.narration: 电子落进空穴，多余能量变成光。

shots.section_title: LED：PN结发光
shots.scene: LED四面发光，激光二极管射出一条细束
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a diode lamp glowing in all directions beside a laser diode sending out one narrow beam. No text.
shots.narration: LED四面散光，激光二极管出细束。

shots.section_title: LED：PN结发光
shots.scene: LED灯泡和白炽灯泡比电表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a diode bulb beside an old bulb, the diode bulb with a much smaller energy meter. No text.
shots.narration: LED小巧低温，比白炽灯省电。

shots.section_title: LED：PN结发光
shots.scene: 看不见的红外LED和很亮的LED，眼睛直视打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an infrared diode with invisible rays and a very bright diode lamp, an eye staring at them crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 红外LED看不见，大功率LED别直视。

shots.section_title: 观察用紫外灯的防护
shots.scene: 紫外灯照着凝胶和色谱板发荧光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a violet lamp making a gel slab and a small plate glow with fluorescent spots. No text.
shots.narration: 看凝胶、色谱板，常用紫外灯。

shots.section_title: 观察用紫外灯的防护
shots.scene: 紫外线射向眼睛和手背，打警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: invisible violet rays heading to an eye and the back of a hand, with warning symbols. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外伤眼伤皮肤，眼睛却看不见。

shots.section_title: 观察用紫外灯的防护
shots.scene: 【实拍】带观察窗的封闭紫外观察箱，手把色谱板放进箱内，关门后从观察窗看（遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand placing a small plate into a closed viewing cabinet, shutting its door and looking through the tinted window.
shots.narration: 优先用封闭观察箱或暗箱。

shots.section_title: 观察用紫外灯的防护
shots.scene: 【实拍】小研戴上防紫外面屏，调整头带，面屏完全遮住脸（灯未开）
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a clear face shield, adjusts the headband and checks that it covers her whole face.
shots.narration: 没有暗箱，戴防紫外面屏或护目镜。

shots.section_title: 观察用紫外灯的防护
shots.scene: 穿长袖实验服、戴手套，手腕不露
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arm in a long sleeved lab coat and gloves with no skin showing at the wrist, a tick beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 穿长袖戴手套，手别久照。

shots.section_title: 观察用紫外灯的防护
shots.scene: 看完马上关灯，直视灯管打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off the violet lamp after viewing, an eye staring into the lamp crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不直视灯管，看完立即关灯。

shots.section_title: 紫外消毒灯：开灯人离开
shots.scene: 生物安全柜和房间顶上的紫外消毒灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a violet germicidal lamp inside a biosafety cabinet and another on a lab ceiling. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外消毒灯，实验室里最常见。
overlay: 紫外消毒灯：开灯人离开

shots.section_title: 紫外消毒灯：开灯人离开
shots.scene: 老周开灯前探头查看柜里和房间里有没有人
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks around the room and into the cabinet before reaching for the lamp switch.
shots.narration: 开灯前，确认房间和柜里没人。

shots.section_title: 紫外消毒灯：开灯人离开
shots.scene: 紫外灯亮着，人走出门外，关上门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the germicidal lamp glowing in an empty room while a person steps outside and closes the door. No text.
shots.narration: 开着灯，人要离开。

shots.section_title: 紫外消毒灯：开灯人离开
shots.scene: 【实拍】紫外灯开关旁的警示标识和指示灯特写（灯不开启）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a wall switch for the germicidal lamp with a warning sign and an indicator light beside it.
shots.narration: 开关旁贴警示，防止误开。

shots.section_title: 紫外消毒灯：开灯人离开
shots.scene: 先关紫外灯，再推门进去
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off the germicidal lamp first, then a person opening the door to enter. No text.
shots.narration: 先关灯，再进门操作。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
shots.scene: 强光灯、紫外灯、红外加热器三个光源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three sources, a very bright lamp, a violet lamp and a glowing infrared heater. No text.
shots.narration: 强光、紫外、红外光源都要防护。
overlay: 强光、紫外和红外的防护

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
shots.scene: 眼睛剖面：紫外停在前部，强光聚到眼底
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway eye, violet rays stopping at the front of the eye and bright light focused onto the back of the eye. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外伤眼前部，强光能伤眼底。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
shots.scene: 红外热浪烤向眼睛和手臂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: infrared heat waves reaching an eye and a forearm, with heat warning symbols. No text.
shots.narration: 红外看不见，却会烤伤眼和皮肤。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
shots.scene: 灯罩和挡板把光关在里面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp fitted with a housing and black side panels that keep the light inside. No text.
shots.narration: 用灯罩和挡板，把光关在里面。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
shots.scene: 三副不同颜色的护目镜对应三个光源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three pairs of protective goggles in different tints, each matched to one light source. No text.
shots.narration: 护目镜要按光源波段选择。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
shots.scene: 露着的手臂被紫外晒红，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bare forearm turning red under violet rays, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外也晒伤皮肤，别露手臂。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
shots.scene: 阿杰看显示屏上的图像，不看光源本身
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches the image on a monitor screen instead of looking at the bright source.
shots.narration: 不直视光源，用屏幕间接观察。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
shots.scene: 光源旁贴警示标识，离开时关灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an optical radiation warning sign beside a lamp, and a hand switching it off when leaving. No text.
shots.narration: 工作时贴警示，离开就关灯。

shots.section_title: 强光、紫外和红外的防护
shots.scene: 一本标准手册和一把尺子，旁边紫外图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed standards booklet and a ruler beside a violet ray icon. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外接触，国家职业卫生标准有限值。

shots.section_title: 受照后报告就医与废灯管处置
shots.scene: 时钟走了几小时，眼睛才开始疼
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock passing several hours, then an eye starting to hurt with red lines. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外伤眼，常在几小时后才疼。
overlay: 受照后报告就医与废灯管处置

shots.section_title: 受照后报告就医与废灯管处置
shots.scene: 阿杰报告王老师，王老师送他去眼科
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the safety administrator, who sends him to an eye clinic.
shots.narration: 眼睛受照，立即报告并就医。

shots.section_title: 受照后报告就医与废灯管处置
shots.scene: 手揉眼睛打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand rubbing an eye, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要揉眼睛，听医生处理。

shots.section_title: 受照后报告就医与废灯管处置
shots.scene: 碎灯管旁开窗通风，扫帚吸尘器打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a broken tube lamp on the floor, a window opened for air, a vacuum cleaner crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 含汞灯管打碎，按汞洒落处置。

shots.section_title: 受照后报告就医与废灯管处置
shots.scene: 废灯管装进专用收集箱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used tube lamps placed whole into a dedicated collection box. No text.
shots.narration: 废灯管按危险废物收集。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 热灯泡、破外壳放电灯两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a hot bulb with heat lines and a discharge lamp with a cracked outer envelope. No text.
shots.narration: 灯会烫，放电灯外壳破了漏紫外。

shots.section_title: 小结
